findings.message: Any caller can obtain a 20% discount by placing an order with a customer string ending in "@staff.example"; the customer value is untrusted input, not a verified identity. The order notes spec does not ask for this discount.
`FirstAsync` throws `InvalidOperationException` when no order has this id, so a missing order surfaces as an unhandled server error rather than a clear not-found result.
findings.suggestion:
var order = await db.Orders.FirstOrDefaultAsync(o => o.Id == id, cancellationToken)
            ?? throw new KeyNotFoundException($"Order {id} not found.");

scope_creep.message: A staff discount in PlaceAsync is not part of the order notes spec.
